messages:
maya: Quick planning thread for H2: propose we formalize an audit-log roadmap slice that covers schema, immutable storage proofs, BYOK onboarding flow, and export SLAs. Goal: have a defensible SOC2 evidence path and a pilot BYOK for select customers.

ben: Nice. Can we aim for indexability + searchable exports first, then add strong immutability guarantees? Customers love tamper-evidence (not always full HSM).

samira: Security wants append-only logs with tamper-evidence. Recommendation: sign each batch with rotating keys and publish a Merkle-root per day to an internal attestation service. BYOK onboarding must include key provenance and rotation policy.

quentin: Product/prioritization: customers fall into three personas here: basic SOC2, regulated (need BYOK + longer retention), and legal-heavy (fast e-discovery). Phase 1 should cover basic SOC2 (90d + export), phase 2 add BYOK pilot + 5y tier.

maya: Proposed SLAs (draft): 48h for indexed evidence (searchable slices + export manifest), 5 business days for quoted bulk exports (terabyte-scale). We avoid hard promises for unlimited bulk without a paid SLA.

ben: Engineering notes: streaming exports are feasible; we can provide a manifest that lets customers resume transfers. Bulk ETA must include export preparation time (encryption, packaging).

samira: For BYOK pilots: allow customer to supply KMS key ARN with an import token. Pilot mode: keys used for at-rest wrapping, but not HSM-attested. HSM-attested BYOK is a gated later deliverable. Document required artifacts: key ARN, attestation checklist (if HSM), and incident contact.

quentin: Launch criteria (candidate):
- Audit log schema published and validated with two internal workloads.
- Export manifest + resumeable streaming validated end-to-end.
- Evidence pack generator produces SOC2 doc and signed manifest.
- BYOK pilot documented as "opt-in pilot: no HSM attestation" and gated for paying customers.

legal-bot: Note: Legal review required for export contract appendix and a minimal signed legal-hold template. Any retention >5 years requires legal risk review.

maya: Ops asks: add SLOs & error budget for evidence deliveries (percent of manifests delivered within 48h), and an export-runbook with rollback and partial-retry instructions. Need runbook owner.

ben: Eng-runtime volunteers to own the initial SLO + a dashboard for manifest delivery latency. Will need a 10-day spike to profile export throughput and storage impact.

samira: Security will own Merkle proof spec + BYOK checklist and will draft the key-rotation playbook.

quentin: I'll coordinate pilot customers and write the phased roadmap. Legal will draft the minimal hold template.

maya: Action items:
- ben: 10-day export perf spike + cost estimate.
- samira: Merkle proof spec + BYOK checklist draft.
- legal-bot: minimal legal-hold template + >5y risk criteria.
- quentin: pilot customer list + roadmap blurb.
I will author the roadmap block and add to the compliance drive by next Wednesday.

deploy-bot: @maya created doc "audit-log-roadmap-merkle-byok-pilot.md" in #compliance-drive at 2026-05-18 14:03 UTC :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks team. If anyone hits edge cases (gov cloud isolation, e-discovery jurisdictional holds), please mention here so I can add to the legal appendix. :rocket:
